topline.text: A genuinely quiet 24-48 hours - no major new national policy, Ofsted, funding or safeguarding story broke overnight or over yesterday.
Nothing new locally in Sheffield or South Yorkshire either, so today's briefing is short rather than padded out - the diary below covers what's actually on leaders' radar this fortnight.

diary.text: Midday deadline for Sheffield secondary school applications for September 2027 entry (national deadline 31 Oct).
Extended deadline for schools to complete autumn census free school meals eligibility rechecks.

box.label: Jargon-buster - the Inclusion judgement
box.intro: Since Ofsted's report-card framework began (from inspections on or after 10 November 2025), schools are graded across six core areas rather than one overall word.
box.text: Inclusion is the new standalone area - covering how well a school supports disadvantaged pupils, those with SEND, and those known to children's social care. It's graded on the same five-point scale as the others (Exceptional, Strong standard, Expected standard, Needs attention, Urgent improvement). Safeguarding sits apart from that scale, judged simply as met or not met.
